text:
eva: Quick sync — PR #45901 updates routing priority and introduces a canary fallback policy. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we schedule a canary. Platform can coordinate timing. PTAL?

kyle: Got it, reading. Main concern is eviction behavior if fallback fires frequently. Runtime, can you confirm this won't spike tail latency on the hot path?

sam (runtime): Skimming now. The fallback looks safe but two quick calls: tighten `max_inflight` from 200 -> 120 and add a lightweight circuit-breaker metric (failure_rate windowed). I'll push a tiny follow-up commit with both.

maria (infra): Need to check node_affinity tweak — that will change packing. Can we do a staged rollout (50% staging traffic) before prod? Also ping me for the smoke-run window so I can watch binpacking.

emily (security): Quick question: does this route add or forward any new headers that could expose user identifiers? Security wants an audit log entry for the rollout and header-scrubbing if needed.

eva: @sam thanks — appreciate the follow-up commit. @maria 50% staging sounds good. @emily we'll add audit logging and scrub headers; i'll update the PR with the checklist. Who can own merge and the first-hour monitoring once we get all LGTM?

sam (runtime): I can own merge + first-hour monitoring. I'll create a dashboard and add a short runbook snippet under the PR. For smoke test run locally: ```bash
# quick smoke
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' 'https://staging.redwood.internal/routing/health'
```

kyle: Sounds good. Waiting for infra + security thumbs. @maria @emily flag any blockers?

maria (infra): Ok from infra after staging smoke. I want the canary to start during a low-traffic window; ping me when you schedule.

emily (security): Ok from security provided headers are scrubbed and an audit log event is emitted for fallback triggers. Leave a comment in PR when those are in.

eva: Great — planning canary for Tue 09:00 PST. I'll mark PR `ready-for-merge` once sam's follow-up commit and the audit/header changes land. Thanks all :thumbsup:
